national_news.title: PM Modi Urges IFS Trainees to Expand Grassroots and Digital Diplomacy Globally
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed 50 Officer Trainees of the 2025 batch of the Indian Foreign Service (IFS) at Seva Teerth.
Urged young diplomats to act as catalytic agents for India's economic engagement, strengthen the digital presence of Indian Missions, and showcase India's civilisational strengths.
Suggested leveraging the 'Bharat ko Janiye' (Know India) Quiz alongside AI and gaming technologies to engage global youth and boost tourism.

national_news.title: Union Home Minister Inaugurates 9th National Security Strategies Conference
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 9th National Security Strategies Conference in New Delhi, featuring over 850 hybrid participants across police and security establishments.
Directed the integration of AI-based analysis on the Multi-Agency Centre (MAC) platform and mandated training under the Home Ministry's PRAHAAR scheme.
Focused on counter-terrorism through UAPA investigations, trial in absentia for fugitives, narcotics control policy, proxy warfare, sub-aerial threats, and a national biosecurity framework.

national_news.title: India and China Hold 25th Round of Special Representatives' Boundary Talks
bullets: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi held the 25th round of Special Representatives' Talks on the India-China Boundary issue in Beijing.
The Special Representatives mechanism, established in 2003, serves as the primary negotiation channel for resolving the bilateral border dispute.
The talks focused on maintaining peace and tranquillity along border areas as a prerequisite for bilateral ties, following the 24th round held in August 2024.

national_news.title: Puducherry Government Introduces Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026
bullets: The Government of Puducherry introduced the Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026 to shift business regulation from permission-based control to a rule-based governance model.
The Bill extends approval exemptions for MSMEs to five years, with a provision for a one-year extension, and introduces auto-generation of Acknowledgement Certificates if not issued on time.
It strengthens 'Invest Puducherry' as a single point of contact for investors and establishes an auto-appeal mechanism for applicants against rejected proposals.

national_news.title: AIIA Launches 'Garbhini Mitra' Maternal Care Skill-Development Course
bullets: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi, launched the 'Garbhini Mitra' course, a six-month offline healthcare skill-development training program for maternal care.
The program integrates classical Ayurvedic frameworks—Garbhadhana Vidhi, Garbhini Paricharya, and Sutika Paricharya—with modern non-clinical healthcare protocols like Basic Life Support (BLS).
Eligible for candidates completing Senior Secondary (10+2) education, the course aims to create community healthcare guides for holistic antenatal, postnatal, and pre-conceptional support.

national_news.title: India Post Launches Upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa Applications
bullets: Union Minister of Communications Jyotiraditya M. Scindia launched the upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa mobile apps along with inaugurating 14 renovated post office buildings across India.
The applications were developed indigenously by the Centre for Excellence in Postal Technology (CEPT) under the Advanced Postal Technology (APT) platform as part of DoP IT 2.0 Modernization.
Dak Sewa provides unified postal services across 23 Indian languages, while Dak MITRA equips postal personnel with digital tools for doorstep service delivery.

national_news.title: RBI Forex Swap Scheme Mobilizes Record $73 Billion Foreign Inflows
bullets: The Reserve Bank of India's special USD-INR forex swap facility mobilized a record US $73 billion in foreign exchange inflows within 11 weeks of its launch.
FCNR(B) deposits from Non-Resident Indians formed the major share, contributing US $65.40 billion to total forex mobilization.
The total mobilization significantly surpassed the US $26 billion raised during RBI's 2013 FCNR(B) swap scheme, prompting RBI to advance the window closure date to August 31, 2026.

national_news.title: India and Russia Review Bilateral Ties and Target $100 Billion Trade by 2030
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow and co-chaired the India-Russia Inter-Governmental Commission meeting with First Deputy PM Denis Manturov.
Both sides discussed strategies to achieve the $100 billion bilateral trade target by 2030 through removing tariff barriers and strengthening payment mechanisms.
Russia offered to step up fertilizer supplies for Indian agriculture, alongside expanding cooperation in energy, trade, and civil nuclear sectors.

national_news.title: India Calls for Sustained Finance for Land Restoration at UNCCD COP17
bullets: Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav addressed the Ministerial Dialogue at the 17th Conference of Parties (COP17) to UNCCD held in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.
Highlighted India's Green Credit Programme, where credits are awarded after five years of restoration on achieving at least 40% canopy density on degraded land.
Emphasized the use of Sovereign Green Bonds and blended green finance to mobilize capital for drought resilience, compensatory afforestation, and biodiversity conservation.

national_news.title: India to Amend Regulations to Boost Manufacturing Investments from Japan
bullets: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal led a 200-business delegation across Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka to strengthen India-Japan economic partnerships.
Announced regulatory updates within two months to resolve investor issues in key areas like semiconductor equipment manufacturing and automotive components.
Engaged in active dialogues on ethical AI usage, clean energy, healthcare, and leveraging free trade agreements for global market access.

national_news.title: Union Sports Ministry Launches 'Khelo India Samvad' Initiative
bullets: The Union Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports organized 'Khelo India Samvad – Khel Ki Baat PM Ke Saath' across colleges in Punjab, Haryana, and Chandigarh.
Executed through the Department of Youth Affairs' 'Mera Yuva Bharat' (MY Bharat) portal, the drive connects youth with national sports and fitness goals.
The initiative promotes youth engagement via the MY Bharat Suggestions Box and encourages participation in the Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue (VBYLD) Quiz.

national_news.title: India Targets $1 Trillion Chemical Sector Economy by 2040
bullets: Union Minister for Chemicals and Fertilisers J.P. Nadda announced a strategic target to expand India's chemical sector to $1 trillion by 2040 during a CEO Roundtable in New Delhi.
The government highlighted key sectoral reforms and policy interventions including Bhavya Rasayan, Coal Gasification, Rare Earth Corridors, and the Critical Mineral Mission.
Invest India and the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals outlined plans to establish an institutionalized dialogue mechanism to enhance domestic manufacturing and attract foreign investments.

national_news.title: ISMA Projects Sugar Price Stabilization Amid Sufficient Domestic Availability
bullets: The Indian Sugar and Bio-energy Manufacturers Association (ISMA) stated that domestic sugar prices are expected to cool off due to adequate stock availability, attributing the recent price surge to speculative and panic buying.
ISMA requested a reduction in the sugar holding limit for traders from 400 tonnes to 200 tonnes to release more stock into the retail market.
The Union Government announced the import of 10 lakh tonnes of sugar as a precautionary measure to maintain comfortable stock levels.

national_news.title: AAI Proposes ₹1,200-Crore Terminal 3 Project at Bhubaneswar Airport
bullets: Airports Authority of India (AAI) submitted a proposal to the Union Finance Ministry’s Public Investment Board (PIB) for constructing Terminal 3 (T3) at Biju Patnaik International Airport, Bhubaneswar.
Estimated at over ₹1,200 crore, the integrated T3 terminal is designed to handle both domestic and international operations under one roof with a capacity of 8.6 million passengers per annum.
The project will add six additional aerobridges to the airport's existing operational infrastructure.

national_news.title: AAI Seeks PIB Approval for ₹1,200-Crore Expansion of Biju Patnaik International Airport
bullets: Airports Authority of India (AAI) has sought Public Investment Board (PIB) approval for a ₹1,200-crore Terminal 3 at Biju Patnaik International Airport in Bhubaneswar.
The integrated terminal will combine domestic (T1) and international (T2) operations, raising total annual passenger capacity to 8.6 million.
The proposed expansion will increase air traffic capacity and equip the airport with six new aerobridges alongside its 18 aircraft aprons.

bihar_news.title: SC Clarifies Electoral Roll Exclusion Does Not Void Citizenship or Social Welfare Rights
bullets: The Supreme Court clarified that deletion from electoral rolls following Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in Bihar does not automatically lead to the loss of citizenship or denial of social welfare benefits.

The bench noted that the Election Commission of India (ECI) conducts enquiries strictly for electoral eligibility, which does not constitute a formal determination of citizenship under the Citizenship Act.
Individuals facing denial of Public Distribution System (PDS) ration or domicile certificates due to voter list exclusion retain the right to seek remedies before the High Court.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Approves 336-km Six-Lane Greenfield Corridor Connecting Buxar to Bhagalpur
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved a 336-km six-lane greenfield road corridor connecting Buxar to Bhagalpur, implemented through the Bihar State Road Development Corporation Limited (BSRDCL).
The corridor will traverse districts including Bhojpur, Arwal, Jehanabad, Nalanda, Munger, Sheikhpura, Banka, Gaya, Nawada, Jamui, and Lakhisarai to boost regional trade and connectivity.
Bihar's Information Technology Department signed an MoU with Japanese firm Tayo to develop an AI-based infrastructure platform to identify, prioritize, and monitor major infrastructure projects.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Forms 5-Member Committee for Examination Reforms
bullets: The Bihar Government issued a notification to set up a 5-member special committee, headed by a serving/retired High Court judge or retired Supreme Court judge, to recommend examination reforms within three months.
The committee covers secondary, higher secondary, university, technical, entrance, and recruitment examinations to prevent paper leaks, cheating, and malpractice.
Key focus areas include adopting AI, digital technology, data analytics, cybersecurity, biometric verification, and CCTV surveillance in examination processes.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Reaffirms Student Credit Card Scheme with Expanded Banking Model
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary confirmed that higher education loans up to ₹4 lakh under the Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme remain fully active.
Under the revised setup, loans up to ₹2 lakh are provided by the Bihar State Education Finance Corporation, while amounts between ₹2 lakh and ₹4 lakh are routed through scheduled commercial banks.
The state approved an expenditure of ₹950 crore for the scheme for FY 2026-27, an increase of ₹64 crore compared to ₹886 crore in FY 2025-26.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans ₹70,000 Crore 126-km Riverfront Corridor to Koilwar
bullets: The Bihar government announced a ₹70,000 crore project to extend the existing 21-km JP Ganga Path into a 126-km riverfront corridor reaching Koilwar on the Sone River.
The funding model comprises ₹20,000 crore directly from the state government budget and ₹50,000 crore targeted from private sector investments.
The project aims to modernize state urban infrastructure, improve regional connectivity, and boost economic opportunities along major river channels.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Constitute 'Mati Kala Board' for Clay Artisans
bullets: Bihar announced the establishment of a 'Mati Kala Board' (Terracotta Art Board) within three months to promote traditional pottery and support the Kumhar (Prajapati) community.
The initiative was announced in Patna on the death anniversary of 13-year-old freedom movement martyr Ramchandra Vidyarthi.
The board will focus on modernizing clay art through technology adoption, skill training, and enhanced market linkage for local artisans.

bihar_news.title: Parliamentary Standing Committee Reviews Bihar's Transport, Heritage, and Tourism Infrastructure
bullets: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Transport, Tourism, and Culture, chaired by MP Sanjay Jha, conducted a review of Bihar's infrastructure and heritage assets.
The panel assessed key transport projects including the proposed greenfield airport, Patna-Purnia and Gorakhpur-Siliguri routes, and NH-27 maintenance.
Cultural and historical site evaluations covered ASI sites like Kumrahar, Khuda Bakhsh Library, Bihar Museum, as well as tourist centers in Bodh Gaya, Rajgir, and Nalanda.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Outlines Industrial Transformation and Governance Initiatives at ET World Leaders Forum
bullets: Bihar showcased its industrial transformation roadmap driven by the slogan 'Build Bihar, Believe in Bihar', focusing on attracting investments in semiconductors and Global Capability Centres (GCC).
Under the 'Sahyog Grievance Redressal Program', which enforces a strict 30-day resolution deadline, the state achieved a 96% resolution rate for over 6,42,000 public complaints.

Key developmental highlights include expanding power capacity from 350 MW to over 10,000 MW with ₹23,000 crore in annual subsidies, and increasing irrigated land from 2.1 million to 4.4 million hectares.
